Beşiktaş (founded 1903, the Black Eagles) are 8th with 7 points from 3 games: 4-1 v Marseille, 3-2 at Hoffenheim, 2-2 v Crystal Palace. Celtic are 35th with 0 points. Celtic's only previous Turkish opponent: Fenerbahçe in 2015 (1-1, 2-2).
